question: The Bist Doab Canal System and Makhu Canal System are associated with which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Bist Doab Canal System and Makhu Canal System are associated with the state of Punjab.**
